contentText:
Sebastian Moss / DatacenterDynamics :

Nvidia unveils Space-1 Vera Rubin for orbital data centers, saying its GPU delivers up to 25x more AI compute for space-based inferencing compared to the H100   —  Will be used by Aetherflux, Axiom Space, Kepler Comms, Planet, Sophia Space & Starcloud  —  Nvidia has developed a space-specific module of its Vera Rubin GPU-CPU platform.
